findings.message: 'MACADDRESS' is not a grok pattern. Logstash refuses to compile an unknown name, so the filter never registers and EVERY line fails to parse - not just the ones this capture touches. Use a defined pattern: NUMBER or BASE10NUM for a decimal, HOSTNAME for a domain, NOTSPACE for anything without a space.

the extraction produced keys on 0 of 20 sample line(s). the pattern matches no sample line. the pattern matches up to %{IP:src_ip}, which fails on '[3163]: DHCPREQUEST for 10.10.5.14 from '. The capture before it, %{WORD:outcome}, matched only 'dhcpd' and stopped at '[3163]: DHCP' - it is too narrow, and that is the one to widen. %{WORD} matches letters, digits and underscore only - NOT a dot, hyphen, colon or slash. For a hostname use %{HOSTNAME}, for any run of non-space characters use %{NOTSPACE}. Until this is right, every field is empty however it is mapped.
